data.textMessage: Perfect 😊 I have the main booking request details. The Oraya team will review availability and follow up here. Your booking is not confirmed yet.

data.question: May I have your full name for the request?

How would you like to continue?

You can keep the request here on WhatsApp, or open the Oraya website to complete it in a guided form.

#oraya_prefill_url#

data.question: Of course 😊 Please tell me what you already know about your stay — dates, villa, and number of guests. You can send everything in one message, or just the details you know for now.
